title: Vorgehen zur Optimierung einer elektrohydraulischen Bedarfsstromsteuerung durch Erweiterung der Systemfreiheitsgrade
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: Electro-Hydraulic Flow-on-Demand System (EBSS) improves the energy efficiency of mobile machinery by reducing throttling losses and through energy recovery and regeneration. Multi-objective optimization expands the system control degrees of freedom while maintaining operability. Simulations on a wheel loader show a 13.7% energy savings, but also a higher probability of failure and higher investment costs, which currently limit its economic feasibility.
